buildCommand: (cd docs && uvx --from mkdocs-material mkdocs build) && mkdir -p deploy/site && cp -r docs/dashboard deploy/dashboard && cp -r docs/site/* deploy/site/
ignoreCommand: test "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_AUTHOR_LOGIN" = "github-actions[bot]" && test "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" = "chore: refresh repository recall index"
